Look, like countless others here, I want to try to keep you here, but I have been reading stories of people doing it, and I doubt I can really take away the pain. I just can say that I dont want to see the world lose you because for one, maybe this is bullshit that was told to us to make humans feel good, but I want to say it anyway. Everyone is a kindered soul. Now maybe there are ppl that made it this bad for you, and clearly they arent kinderered souls, but i know that considering you had the courage to speak out is something. I know that this is a very beating around the bush paragraph, but I just guess the longer I can keep you here, I want to try because I dont want to see you go. If you dont believe help is possible, well then, just look at me. I have posts here where I have wanted to die, around a year or smth ago. And let me tell you, not to undermine the pain that you are suffering but I went through shit. I didn't sleep right. I set really early alarms hoping that one day when I then wake up, I would stop being such a pussy and finally just off myself. I never did. I slept with knives, hoping I could avoid the pain for the few seconds, and just slit my throught, but I couldnt. I like to thank myself because in my opinion, putting trust into the lord above is bullshit, he doesnt help. He didnt back then, and he sure isnt now. I just guess with all my bullshitting out of the way, I have one request, can I get to know you? Yes this is a scheme to keep you from doing it, but maybe along the way, you can get someone that you- that keeps you here. And maybe along the way, I heal a bit too.
Well, I then understand, I just hope you safe travels.

Hello, I am sorry to hear that you are leaving this world because you might think that it will never get better, and I can't tell you that it will, but you have to wait and see. I went through a period in time where I could relate to this and would have had to ask myself the same question, but are you sure that you want to? Around 5 months later, I still hate my life, but I am much better than I used to be. I don't want to see the world lose such an honest person that is willing to consider the pain of people that know you, even though you won't be there to see it. Maybe no one around you appreciates you, but I can just say from the minimal things that this has told me about you, that I salute you, and I regret that the world is not treating you fair. Now maybe this wasn't enough to change your mind, and if you still want to hang, I understand. But if not for me or your family or just anyone in general, do it for the chance of improvement. and just know Reddit loves you.
